## Affected component

Controller / simulator bridge / evaluation / experiment protocol / result artifact / documentation claim / other.

## Problem

Describe the observed behavior and why it may alter research meaning.

## Reproduction or evidence

Provide the smallest reproducible case, logs, result artifact, or code location available.

## Provenance

Include relevant commit, config, evaluator/result identifier, and seed or run identifier when applicable.

## Potentially affected results

List results or claims that may require re-evaluation. Distinguish confirmed impact from suspected impact.
